extension.description: A Freelens-inspired Kubernetes explorer built into VS Code: clusters, workloads, live updates, metrics, logs, shells, Helm and port forwarding.
capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces: In Restricted Mode, the kubectl and helm paths can only come from user or machine settings, never from the workspace.

config.helmPath: Path to the `helm` binary, used by the **Helm** views.
config.watch: Keep lists up to date in real time with `kubectl get --watch`. When disabled, lists are polled every `#kubexplorer.pollInterval#` seconds.
config.pollInterval: Polling interval, in seconds, for lists that cannot be watched (metrics, Helm, demo cluster) or when `#kubexplorer.watch#` is disabled.
config.reuseTab: Reuse the current KubeXplorer tab when opening another resource type from the Resources view. Use **Open in New Tab** to keep a tab open.
config.appearance.vscode: Follow the current VS Code color theme.
config.appearance.freelens: Use the original dark palette of Freelens.
config.confirmApply: Ask for confirmation before applying a saved YAML document to the cluster.
config.protectedContexts: Contexts to protect, e.g. production: patterns matched against the context names (`*` matches any text). Changes to their objects ask you to type the name of their target, or are refused (`#kubexplorer.protectedContextsMode#`). Their tabs and status bar item are framed in red.
config.protectedContextsMode: How the contexts of `#kubexplorer.protectedContexts#` are protected.
config.protectedContextsMode.confirm: Every change (apply, delete, scale, restart, rollback, debug...) asks you to type the name of its target.
config.protectedContextsMode.readOnly: No change is allowed: the actions that change the cluster, and shells, are hidden; YAML documents open read-only.
config.logs.tailLines: Number of past log lines shown when opening logs.
config.debug.image: Default image of the ephemeral containers of **Debug** (`kubectl debug`).
config.fleet.groups: Groups of clusters of the fleet: group name → context patterns (`*` matches any text). A context belongs to the first group that matches, or to `other`. The Clusters view shows the contexts by group, and the Fleet tab compares the clusters of a group.
config.fleet.contexts: Contexts the Fleet tab scans (patterns, `*` matches any text). Opening the Fleet tab reads these clusters (nodes and Flux objects), never changes them.
config.fleet.concurrency: Clusters the Fleet tab reads at the same time (each read is one `kubectl` process). The diagnostics of the fleet use half of it.
config.fleet.refreshInterval: Seconds between two scans of the fleet, while the Fleet tab is visible. Nothing is scanned when it is hidden or closed.
config.prometheus: Prometheus service of the usage charts, as `namespace/service:port` (e.g. `monitoring/prometheus-server:80`), reached through the API server proxy. Empty: detected among the services of the cluster. `off`: use only the samples of metrics-server.
config.demoCluster: Add a fictitious, offline demo cluster to the Clusters view.
